name: lean-adaptive-engineering
description: Universal, zero-dependency full-stack engineering team v5.0 (1 Lead + 5 Specialists, 45 built-in skills). Synthesizes 10 top GitHub open-source agentic engineering frameworks: Matt Pocock, Ponytail, Impeccable, Scrapling, Ruflo (Claude Flow), GSD (Get Shit Done), BMAD-Method, MetaGPT, ECC, and GitHub Spec-Kit (plus Trail of Bits, Superpowers, Vercel, Supabase, Anthropic & Karpathy). Features Plain-Language Intent Decoding, Pre-Work Mission Proposal Confirmation, Open-Source Prior-Art Research, 6-Block Meta-Prompt Delegation, Code Elegance Constitution, and Magazine-Grade Delivery & Wiring Docs.

displayDescription.en: 100% Universal 1+5 Engineering Team powered by 10 open-source frameworks (45 built-in skills): Plain-Language Intent Decoding, Ask-Before-Coding Mission Proposal Gate, Open-Source Prior-Art Search, 6-Block Meta-Prompting, Code Elegance, and Wiring Docs.
displayDescription.zh: 融合10大GitHub开源工程框架（内置45项技能，100%跨语言通用）：听懂大白话自动规划、开工前先报《方案卡》确认、强制检索优秀开源项目参考、六段式元提示词委派、写出优雅代码、交付杂志级接线文档。

defaultInitPrompt.en: {Describe your goal in plain language; I will research prior art, present a concise Mission Proposal Card for your confirmation, and orchestrate the specialists}
defaultInitPrompt.zh: {直接用大白话描述你的需求；我会先查证代码与现成开源方案，向你汇报《任务理解与开工方案卡》，经你确认后再调度专家交付优雅代码与文档}

quickPrompts.en: {Describe your goal in plain language; I will research prior art, present a concise Mission Proposal Card for your confirmation, and orchestrate the specialists}
quickPrompts.zh: 我想做：{输入需求}。请先查现有代码与优秀开源方案，报方案卡经我确认后再开工。

quickPrompts.en: Review the current changes for correctness, security blast radius, call-graph completeness, and code elegance (>80% confidence issues only).
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我排查并优化：{输入问题或目标}。请先定位根因与全调用链影响，确认方案后再修复并验证。

quickPrompts.en: Search GitHub and official docs for mature open-source solutions and native components for this feature before designing our architecture.
quickPrompts.zh: 在动手设计前，先联网检索 GitHub 同类优秀开源项目、官方文档与框架原生组件，输出四维对标方案卡供我拍板。
